normative_citations.text: Overall acceptance also requires all completed campaign runs retained, identity/authorization/log completeness, no contamination, no rule changes and resource compliance.
normative_citations.effect: An unqualified additional resource-compliance condition, not expressly scoped to latest valid reports.

normative_citations.text: Budget overrun, unavailable tools/source or interrupted/incomplete reports are honestly blocked/unscorable and cannot count toward acceptance.
normative_citations.effect: Initial overrun cannot count as a successful report. Wording does not expressly restore campaign eligibility after repair.

Explicit repair sequence; latest-development thresholds; retained runs; unscorable_counts_as_pass=false; blocked_unscorable_no_silent_retry. JSON does not contain explicit resource-overrun-repair exception to jointly normative overall condition.

reasoning: 201 inclusive lines is a resource violation under the unchanged200 rule, even though dev1 conservative100 guidance is compliant. Later instruction/product changes do not retroactively alter that event.

An explicit repair within the3-round limit avoids treating dev1 as a hidden retry; retaining and not counting old unscorable reports satisfies those particular requirements. It does not by itself establish the separate overall resource-compliance condition.

Literal broad reading of RUBRIC item7 leaves campaign resource compliance unsatisfied. A narrower reading could apply compliance only to countable reports and allow the bounds provision plus explicit repair sequence to restore eligibility. The joint text does not expressly say which scope governs an evaluator infrastructure/read overrun.

Therefore I cannot certify permission to lock/proceed toward acceptance. The unqualified condition is at least an unresolved material ambiguity, triggering mandatory BLOCKED under RUBRIC9 and RULES conflict_policy. A score of10, no holdout leakage and agent agreement do not resolve it.

This classification is not a new K-cap or recalculation of valid dev1 source-advice grades; original grades/manifest remain intact. It also does not claim that every ordinary failed development score permanently ends a campaign: numeric-quality repair is explicitly authorized, while prior resource noncompliance lacks a clear forgiveness provision.
